specs_json.compute: onboard embedded vision computer, ~2000 fps object detection pipeline; L4 autonomy with remote assist

notes: Six-wheeled sidewalk delivery robot operating at pedestrian speed (~6 km/h) with a locked, insulated ~10 kg cargo bay opened via customer app. Fleet exceeds 3,000 robots and 10M+ deliveries across 8 countries; newer generations add radar and improved night/winter operation. Gen 3 ('e-model') specifics are not fully published; battery/sensor values reflect company-published platform figures.

failure_modes.name: Wheel hub motor failure from water/grit ingress
failure_modes.symptoms: Pulling to one side, current spikes, stranded robot
failure_modes.mitigation: Seal inspections, post-winter refurb (salt exposure), motor current trend monitoring

failure_modes.name: Curb-climb suspension linkage wear
failure_modes.symptoms: Clunking on curbs, reduced climb ability, misalignment
failure_modes.mitigation: Scheduled linkage/bushing replacement, curb-impact telemetry review

failure_modes.name: Cellular connectivity dead zones
failure_modes.symptoms: Loss of remote-assist, robot stops and waits, delivery delays
failure_modes.mitigation: Multi-carrier SIM failover, coverage-aware routing, store-and-forward telemetry

failure_modes.name: Camera lens fouling (rain/mud/snow)
failure_modes.symptoms: Degraded obstacle detection, increased operator interventions
failure_modes.mitigation: Hydrophobic coatings, operator alerting on percept confidence drop, field cleaning rounds

failure_modes.name: Battery capacity fade in cold climates
failure_modes.mitigation: Thermal management, winter duty derating, pack replacement thresholds

failure_modes.name: Cargo lid lock actuator jam
failure_modes.symptoms: Customer unable to open lid, remote unlock required
failure_modes.mitigation: Actuator lubrication schedule, remote override, debris seals
